originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp: Herrmann-Joswig-Speyer (arXiv:1112.1278) enumerates the Dr(3,8) fan (rays/rigidity) with no per-cell realizability verdicts; Bendle-Boehm-Ren-Schroeter (arXiv:2003.13752, abstract verified live) computes TGr_0(3,8) with obstructions for 23 special cones via a different computational route, not this explicit F_2(t) Fano-plus-free-point lifting matrix; Baker-Lorscheid (arXiv:2008.00014) and Baker-Lorscheid-Zhang (arXiv:2310.19952, abstracts verified live) give general foundation/pasture theory and the building-block list without deciding any Dr(3,8) cell; Speyer-Sturmfels (math/0304218, verified live) works out only G_{3,6}. No prior source records this matrix, its valuation vector w, or the M0\7=F7 lifting verdict; it is not mechanically implied by fan data (realizability requires exhibiting the valued-field point). Internal prior scan hits (SCOPE026/069/029 etc.) concern abstract GF(3)/Tutte censuses, not valuated-matroid cone interiors or valued-field tropicalizations.

value.rationale: Headline is a rigorously established exact invariant of a specific natural object: the Pluecker valuation vector of an explicit Fano-anchored valuated matroid and its realizability verdict (w in Dr(3,8) cap TGr(3,8), M0\7=F7). The object (Dr(3,8) Fano-type cell lifting) and invariant (realizable vs obstructed) were motivated before computation by the recognized Dressian-vs-Grassmannian gap at n=8; the value (exact w distribution 40/6/3/7, M0 structure) was not known or mechanically implied; a future researcher on matroid realization or tropical lifting could reasonably need this precise citable matrix-plus-valuations fact. This is the admitted fallback claim judged separately from the unfinished window census, which the draft honestly disclaims. Per instructions, one exact witness/datum of this kind is independently retrievable and not rejected merely for lacking a general theorem or completed census; certification does not rescue an arbitrary object but this object is natural and pre-motivated, not arbitrary.
